deals.headline: Kita's holding company waives €45.6m of loans to FC Nantes
deals.investor: Flava Groupe SAS (Waldemar Kita's holding company)
deals.source_name: Mediacités (quoting FC Nantes's filed 2025 social report)
deals.summary: According to the 2025 filing quoted by Mediacités, Flava Groupe granted a financial debt waiver of €45.6m on 30 June 2025, with a return-to-better-fortune clause (repayable if the club's finances recover). Mediacités puts the total lent to the club by Kita's holding since 2007 at about €130m. The DNCG 2024/25 accounts show an exceptional result of 45,681 k€.

deals.evidence: Le montant du rachat est annoncé à 100 millions d'euros (plus 25 millions de part variable)
deals.headline: Kita signs agreement in principle to sell FC Nantes to Paulo Tavares-led investors
deals.investor: Phenix Sports Invest (Paulo Tavares) with French, Portuguese and Luxembourg investors
deals.summary: An agreement in principle signed on 29 September 2026 opens exclusive negotiations with Phenix Sports Invest, Paulo Tavares's company, backed by French, Portuguese and Luxembourg investors. RMC Sport reported the price at €100m plus €25m of variable payments; AFP reported about €30m placed in an escrow account. The deal needs works-council consultation and DNCG approval and had not completed as of 3 October 2026. A 2019 sale to LFE Football Group was blocked by the DNCG, and an August 2026 report of a protocol with British-backed investors was denied by Kita's camp.

name: Football Club de Nantes
notes: The earlier record had no sourced facts. League: the key says Ligue 1, but FC Nantes was relegated in spring 2026 and plays Ligue 2 in 2026-27; the 2024/25 financials are from a Ligue 1 season. Financials come from the LFP/DNCG individual club accounts for 2024/25 (k€, SASP plus association). The 120 k€ pre-tax profit depends on a 45,681 k€ exceptional item, which matches the €45.6m loan waiver by Kita's holding company on 30 June 2025. Before it, the result before player trading was -52,807 k€ and player trading added 7,990 k€. The DNCG balance sheet shows financial debts of 2,666 k€, cash of 6,012 k€ and shareholder current accounts of 2,082 k€; net debt is not stated, so it is left null. The 2007 purchase price (€10m, AFP via L'essentiel) is in the summary only, not in the owner row, because the row cites Sportune for the 99.98% stake. No page read states La Beaujoire's capacity, so it is null. The pending sale to Phenix Sports Invest is an agreement in principle, not a closed deal; the price is as RMC Sport reported it. No valuation, attendance, shirt sponsor, kit supplier or social count was read on a citable page.

owners.evidence: Waldemar Kita y apparaît comme bénéficiaire direct, avec 99,98 % des parts et des droits de vote du club
owners.name: Waldemar Kita (through his holding company Flava Groupe SAS)

ownership_summary: Waldemar Kita, a Franco-Polish businessman, has controlled FC Nantes since August 2007, when he bought it from Socpresse (then owned by Serge Dassault), reportedly for €10m. Sportune reports he holds 99.98% of the shares and voting rights as beneficial owner; Mediacités reports the club is held through his Belgian holding company, Flava Groupe SAS, which waived €45.6m of loans to the club on 30 June 2025. His son Franck Kita is deputy chief executive. On 29 September 2026 Kita signed an agreement in principle opening exclusive talks to sell to investors led by Paulo Tavares's Phenix Sports Invest (reported at €100m plus €25m variable). The sale still needs DNCG approval and had not completed by 3 October 2026.
